observations.content: Updated FrontierInfrastructureEvent in tools/skill-eval/src/model.rs with serde-defaulted charged_millionths_of_dollar: u64 for backward-compatible persisted events.

Updated frontier spending in tools/skill-eval/src/service.rs to include charged infrastructure-event costs with checked overflow arithmetic, persist charges on infrastructure failures, classify invalid arguments/configuration as terminal, and pause other failures for infrastructure retry.

Added and adjusted frontier lifecycle, report, scheduler, and store tests for infrastructure charges, resume behavior, legacy deserialization, and trial usage; restored the original infrastructure_retry_is_persisted_and_bounded_across_resume test.

Completed: ran cargo fmt --all and targeted frontier lifecycle, report, store, and scheduler tests; all reported tests passed, including 18 scheduler tests and 16 store tests, with compiler dead-code warnings only.
